desc:
🎨 Spread your color across the board. Step on it. Claim it. Own it. 🎨

Claim the map! Don't let your color trail get stepped on!

🖌️ Expand your influence by painting the board in your color
🌈 Capture tiles across the arena and push back competing players
👑 Complete quests and level up to go faster
✨ Equip stylish trails, patterns, and visual effects to stand out
🏆 Rise through the rankings and compete for #1
🎭 Collect rare skins and unlock special power-ups as you progress

Do you have what it takes to dominate the map and become the ultimate color champion? 🚀
If you’re having fun, don’t forget to leave a 👍
